title: Failure Cascade Universe: Concept Specification
description: Failure Cascade Universe — Concept Specification. Simulates how one component failure can propagate across connected machines, applications, facilities, or supply chains.
body: The Failure Cascade Universe (catalog entry 607, System Simulators) is a proposed Signature-original capability for the JAH Network apex simulator-generator family. Simulates how one component failure can propagate across connected machines, applications, facilities, or supply chains. This concept specification states the problem it solves, the class of inputs it accepts, and the class of outputs it promises. It is designed to live in the Signature ecosystem alongside the other apex tools: it exchanges tool definitions, simulation results, and evidence packs through the shared apex registry, and every artifact it produces is expected to carry its provenance, tests, and recorded results with it. This record describes a PROPOSED capability, not a completed product. Nothing here claims the tool has been built, independently verified, or deployed. Design rule: a generated tool is NOT marked operational until it has a defined interface, a successful build, meaningful tests, and recorded results.
